transcript.content: Hello, I'm glad you could make it in today. What brings you in to see me?
I’ve been feeling low for a long time. I wake up with this heavy, gray feeling already on me, even before I get to the clinic, and it pretty much stays with me all day.
About how long have you been feeling this low mood?
About two years and a couple months now. It started around when the clinic changed staffing and my schedule began rotating all over the place.
During these past two years, have there been any periods of two months or more where your mood lifted and you felt back to normal?
No, I haven’t had a stretch like that. It’s been there pretty much continuously for the whole two years and two months, since the staffing change and my schedule started rotating.
Have you ever had a period of time where you felt the opposite—unusually energized, elated, or hyper, with much less need for sleep?
I’m not sure what would count, but I haven’t noticed any times where I felt unusually up or hyper like that.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you used to enjoy doing?
Yeah. I used to play basketball and work on little electronics projects with my friends, but I’ve stopped going. I just can’t keep up with anything outside of work anymore.
Before this started two years ago, had you ever experienced any periods of depression in your life?
I’m not really sure. I don’t remember having anything like this before then.
How has your sleep been over these past two years?
I’m not sure. What do you mean exactly—like trouble falling asleep, or sleeping too much?
Have you been experiencing either trouble falling or staying asleep, or sleeping much more than usual?
I don’t know, honestly. I haven’t really paid attention to whether it’s one of those things.
How have your energy levels been over these past two years?

Yeah, I’m tired most of the time. Even if I sleep late or have a day off, I still feel worn out. After rooming patients and catching up on charts, I usually feel like I’ve got nothing left for laundry, shooting hoops, or messing with my electronics stuff.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or eating habits over this time?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed any big change in how I eat, I guess.
How have you been feeling about yourself lately, in terms of your self-worth or confidence?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really thought about my confidence or self-worth that much.
Have you noticed any difficulty concentrating or making decisions at work or at home?

Yeah. At work I’ll stare at the patient intake screen and have to read the same line a few times before it sinks in. I’ve missed little things, like medication doses, or lost track of what I was about to ask next.
